_meta.authority: tokens.css is the source of truth. This file is a BUILD INPUT generated from it — do not hand-edit, and do not treat a disagreement between the two as ambiguous: tokens.css wins.
_meta.canonical: tokens.tokens.json (W3C DTCG) is the canonical interchange and carries the full reasoning for every token. This file carries the same values in Style Dictionary's shape, with each token's ONE JOB as its comment.
_meta.warning: Any platform file emitted from this source must preserve the light/dark split as two themes over ONE set of names. A build that flattens dark into separate token names (ink-dark, paper-dark) breaks the rule that no component knows which theme it is in.

sheet.comment: A panel ON the sheet. 1.08:1 — barely there, and meant to be.

tile-hover.comment: Pointer over a tile. A ground change, never a hue change. 1.16:1.

base.comment: 14.05 paper / 12.97 sheet. Everything that must be read.

refused.comment: 6.57 / 6.07. REFUSED or never built. Never cleared work.

recede.comment: 4.92 / 4.54. CLEARED work. BELOW AA on sheet — not for text on a panel.

rule.comment: 1.38 / 1.28. Hairline between rows. THE VISIBLE FLOOR.

on-ink-2.comment: 8.49 on ink. Secondary on ink grounds.

base.comment: 4.55 / 4.20. MEASUREMENT ONLY — the meter, and nothing else. Below AA on sheet: fine for a 3px graphic object, not for text.

deep.comment: 10.39 / 9.59. Agent TEXT, and the committing button's hover.

base.comment: 6.73 / 6.21. WAYFINDING ONLY, and it reinforces rather than carries. Deliberately outside the brand's green family — a second green reads as a second agent state.

quiet.comment: The selected row's ground. Paired with the 2px edge, never alone.

hot.comment: The hot centre at 0%. A SOURCE WITH FALLOFF, never a fill.

edge.comment: The inset hairline around a lit thing.

hatch.comment: The not-built stripe. 1.42:1 on both light grounds — just above ink.rule. The alpha form is what makes it ground-independent.

radius.comment: Square under R2. The single revert point — the sheet's own corner is .09em.

clear-space.comment: The badge's own width on every side. In em so it travels with the mark.

min-size.comment: Of badge. Below this, use the glyph alone.

s1.comment: 11px. Micro, uppercase, tracked. FIXED — does not scale with the viewport.

s3.comment: 14px. Body, the default. FIXED — already at the readable floor.

lede.comment: The one lede, and the s6 figure.

figure.comment: A monospaced thing that must not look bold.

emph.comment: Emphasis, and every uppercase micro label.

mark.comment: The wordmark and the glyph. Nothing else.

note.comment: Unitless. size.s2 prose — LOOSER than body, because smaller lines are easier to lose.

text.comment: Body and note prose. The ceiling.

lede.comment: The one lede. Shorter because it is bigger.

act.comment: A sentence a person must ACT on.

u.comment: 4px at a 16px root. Every gap is a multiple. THE HALF-UNIT IS THE FLOOR.

min.comment: 24px. WCAG 2.2 AA 2.5.8 floor. In rem so a larger font setting gives a larger target. A floor, not a design target.

base.comment: 32px. What the system's controls actually are.

measure.comment: 1180px. A PAGE. Does not grow above the ultra tier.

col-min.comment: 248px. The floor of an auto-fit column.

form.comment: 408px. The entry-tier form column. NOT measure — they move for different reasons.

bp-narrow.comment: CONSTANT, not a usable token — a custom property cannot be read inside @media.

bp-wide.comment: CONSTANT. Above it the drawer becomes an inline column.

floor.comment: The reflow floor. 1.4.10 — a requirement, not a choice.

spring.comment: A damped spring (zeta 0.6, omega-n 18) sampled at eleven points. Anything that MOVES, on the way IN. Restarts rather than retargeting — that trade is why it is one token and not a library.

t-fade.comment: Opacity and colour, and the way OUT. A leaving element does not bounce.

sweep.comment: AMBIENT. 88% of the cycle at rest — the rest fraction is the load-bearing part.

scrim.comment: Behind a drawer or a modal. The only exception to the no-shadow rule.

sheet-shadow.comment: Not a shadow — a hairline under a panel.

skip.comment: The skip link. Highest, because it must work when something else has gone wrong.

dark._comment: A DIMMED LIGHT THEME — one dark ground, every other step recomputed against it. Same names, same jobs. on-ink and on-ink-2 invert in DIRECTION because an ink ground here is a light panel; the name still describes the job.

rule.comment: 1.37:1 — the same relationship to the ground it has in the light theme.

base.comment: 5.45:1. LIGHTENED — the light hex is 1.5:1 here. Better than the light theme's 4.55, because the green no longer competes with white.

hot.comment: A source on a dark ground is the case the luminous touch was always describing. DIMMED by the owner's ruling (G3661, "Dim the dark glow") so --muted holds >=4.5:1 everywhere on a lit cell, sweep included.

hatch.comment: 1.55:1. INVERTS OR IT DISAPPEARS — a dark stripe on a dark ground is the not-built defect in its purest form.
